name: Set Caverns
intro: Crystals here are one of a kind. No copies.
In these caves, each thing appears once.
Sets hold unique things. Nothing repeats.

1: Two crystals that look the same... refuse to stack.
The cave keeps only one of each.
Every member here is a first.
Add a thing twice and see.
2: A set is a collection with no repeats.
You add members to a set.
You check if a set holds a thing.
Sets never store a thing twice.

ok: A unique crystal joins the cluster.
No copies here. That one fits.
The cave accepts a new member.
error: That one is already here. Sets say no to copies.

curiosity: Try adding the same member twice.
I wonder what your set holds now.
humor: Two of the same is just one with an ego.
Sets are the world's best bouncers.
This cave has no storage for duplicates.
wisdom: Uniqueness is the rule of the cave.
Counts are the whole power of a set.
Check before you add. Or just add.
sternness: I told you twice. Sets reject copies.
Do not test the cave's patience.
